English / code: A verified snapshot is also taken automatically every 24 hours. Restoring is done from the server command line (see the Backup guide) with the service stopped.

Add: authorised deductions recovered from staff

Somali (current): Aasaaska komishanka: qadarka saafiga ah ee adeegga ka dib qiimo dhimis iyo soo celin, iyadoo laga reebay canshuurta iyo tip-ka. Ganacsiga ku hadhay waa ka hor kiro, korontada iyo kharashyada kale.

English / code: Company logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 2 MB; wide PNG with transparent or dark background works best)
Somali (current): Summadda shirkadda (PNG, JPEG ama WebP, ugu badnaan 2 MB; PNG ballaaran oo asal hufan ama madow ayaa ugu fiican)

English / code: Company name (shown on receipts, invoices, reports)
Somali (current): Magaca shirkadda (ka muuqda rasiidada, faktuurada, warbixinnada)

Somali (current): Dhammaystir dalab kasta marka macmiilku lacagta bixiyo.

English / code: Each barber earns the percentage of the service amount plus the fixed fee for every haircut/service, never more than the amount charged. New rates apply to services recorded from now on; earlier visits keep their rate. Every change is kept in the rate history.
Somali (current): Berber kasta wuxuu helaa boqolleyda qiimaha adeegga iyo lacagta go'an ee timo-jar/adeeg kasta, mana dhaafo qiimaha la qaaday. English / code: Each branch manager signs in with their own account and sees only their branch: sales, stock, staff work, expenses and profit.
Somali (current): Maamule kasta wuxuu ku galaa akoonkiisa gaarka ah wuxuuna arkaa laantiisa oo kaliya: iibka, bakhaarka, shaqada shaqaalaha, kharashyada iyo faa'iidada.

English / code: Each label carries a QR code with the item code. Stick it on the item; scanning it with the phone or the shop camera brings up the item, its price and the maximum discount.
Somali (current): Calaamad kasta waxay leedahay koodh QR oo wata koodka shayga. Ku dheji shayga; marka lagu iskaano mobilka ama kamaradda dukaanka waxaa soo baxaya shayga, qiimihiisa iyo qiimo dhimista ugu badan.
Iibka elektarooniga iyo hagaajinta oo isku jira

English / code: Email, SMS and WhatsApp are NOT connected.
Somali (current): Iimayl, SMS iyo WhatsApp lama xirin.

Somali (current): Faa'iidada saafiga ah = dakhliga adeegga saafiga ah - komishan - alaabta la isticmaalo - kharashyada shaqada (kiro, koronto, agab...).
